card.name: Section numbers in cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits and closing brackets inside section cross-references such as "see Dosage and Administration (2.x)". Also the asterisk after "See below" in dosing tables.

modes.label: Section number reference
modes.description: The digit or closing parenthesis inside a bracketed section pointer in a drug label.

modes.label: Table footnote asterisk
modes.description: An asterisk after "See below" in a weight-based dosing table, pointing to a footnote.
modes.example: More than 114 kg 0.075 mg/kg See below<<*>> *Calculate the injection volume for these patients
